head: feature/phase7-budget-aware-learning
title: ProofLab v0.7.0: budget-aware completion learning with frozen negative results
body:
Phase 6's learned controller predicts cost only among successful searches and can select an expert that never completes within budget. This adds CPU completion prediction, conditional-cost regression and joint/conservative routing trained on real root and intermediate Lean continuations.

The frozen new evaluation establishes **no gain over the strongest staged search**: Phase 6 staged, Phase 7 completion and conservative each solve 44/48; the previous learned controller solves 39/48. Completion/conservative/root-trained reproduce the staged control's complete action sequence on all 48 tasks. Joint and cost-only each solve 40/48; joint has two gains and six regressions against staged. These negative results are retained without test-driven retuning.

- Preserve all 6,051 original research/model/example files and all Phase 1–6 executable freezes.
- Retain 64 development source searches, 684 matched continuations (477 independently verified / 207 bounded noncompletions), selected linear/nonlinear CPU models and all 528 new evaluation traces. Dataset, models and execution sources were committed before final evaluation.
- Add Policy Learning Explorer with actual completion/cost estimates, decision reasons, native goals/trees, matched development continuations, complete exports and cancellable local search. All prior explorers remain available.
- Provide exact reproduction instructions, mathematical examples, calibration/behavior diagnostics, figures and the [detailed v0.7.0 research report](https://github.com/Marci99forgrateful/prooflab/blob/feature/phase7-budget-aware-learning/docs/phase-7-final-report.md).

Validation: 152 full-suite Python tests passed (including Lean and browser checks), twenty JavaScript tests passed, strict lint/format/type checks and Lean/frontend builds passed. The three Policy Explorer browser checks also passed after its final initial-fit correction; four exported proof files passed separate native Lean audits. The static subdirectory explorer also passed without a backend/CDN, and the Pages export was checked in a base-dependency-only virtual environment. Original artifacts and frozen execution hashes remain unchanged. Hosted validation: https://github.com/Marci99forgrateful/prooflab/actions/runs/41658447766 (successfully completed on source commit `82097fa`).

Base: `feature/phase6-adaptive-hybrid` (`a8af9eb8698819d07bb10f7f1bacd855f9b1213a`). Draft review only; no automatic merge, MathVerify modification, paid AI API or GPU use.
